meaning:
συν-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ma.2:4 2Mac 2:6 * ;]
to follow along with, accompany: with dative of person(s), Mrk.14:51, Luk.23:49; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), Mrk.5:37.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He allowed no one to follow him, except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.
